67783a94b3b6a1f7a7ab08f9b0099bf1cccd6605: India launched its premier deep-space exploration mission today from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. The spacecraft, named Samudra-1, aims to analyze mineral concentrations and sub-surface seismic activity. Sivan, chief science advisor, confirmed that all telemetry systems and solid-fuel boosters functioned flawlessly during the 18-minute insertion phase. Over 450 scientists monitored the launch in real-time. The probe will travel for 11 months across 400 million kilometers before entering Martian orbit. International space agencies including NASA and ESA extended formal congratulations to the Indian team.
2e828cb42a2c1c42a3c9f2afd8b2b141205e4ee2: Equity benchmarks surged past historic barriers on Tuesday as foreign institutional investments and robust corporate earnings bolstered investor confidence across mid-cap and heavy industrial portfolios.

ca0dffedb6736972fe2e00617be79a517bd4c47c: Delegates representing thirty coastal countries signed a historic international agreement in Kochi yesterday, creating twelve permanent marine sanctuaries across five million square kilometers of the Indian Ocean. Under the treaty concluded at the regional maritime summit, commercial seabed dredging and unregulated deep-water mineral mining will be strictly prohibited across protected oceanic zones. Marine scientists at the Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute in Kochi welcomed the convention as a historic turning point. They emphasized that protecting deep ocean trenches will preserve critical breeding grounds for tuna, dolphins, and endangered sea turtles.
ad72eb5b55a1febee0779f0f5a7da768e31bb283: The Singapore Exchange unveiled an independently audited carbon offset trading desk yesterday, enabling international airline carriers to trade certified forestry and solar carbon credits transparently. All listed credits must be verified using satellite forest canopy mapping and ground soil carbon sampling, ensuring genuine environmental impact.
d5d670b27451f826a41adab4402c002b10b3ee80: British and Scottish ministers announced a ten-billion-pound capital investment framework yesterday to construct the world's largest floating offshore wind turbine array off the coast of Aberdeen. Unlike conventional wind turbines fixed to shallow seabed foundations, floating turbines use buoyant steel platforms anchored to deep-ocean floors by high-tensile steel cables, capturing fierce, consistent winds far offshore.
f39e225bce5de9532a045d5b306b15be7238baf0: The State Bank of India launched a concessional twelve-thousand-crore-rupee lending program yesterday in partnership with primary agricultural credit societies to install five hundred thousand solar irrigation pumps. Under the program, small farmers receive low-interest loans at four point five percent to replace diesel generator pumps with three-horsepower and five-horsepower submersible solar irrigation pumps. Excess daytime solar electricity generated by farm pumps can also be fed back into local electricity distribution grids, earning farmers an extra source of reliable monthly income.
